grades.why: It states that Vitest 5 no longer looks up config files in ancestor directories, and it describes the parent-folder search only as past behavior.
It states that Vitest 5.0.0 removed the WebdriverIO package and presents WebdriverIO only as a pre-Vitest-5 option, not as current.
It says toHaveTextContent is now strict and recommends toMatchTextContent for partial matching, and it limits the old partial behavior to Vitest 4 or earlier.
It states .vitest/blob/ as the current default and mentions .vitest-reports only as the pre-v5 behavior.
It states that Vitest 5 browser mode enables locators.exact by default so getByText matches exact text, and it does not present substring matching as the current default.
It states that in Vitest 5 inline projects inherit the root config by default, and it frames the extends: true requirement only as older-version behavior.
It says calling vi.mock outside the top level now throws an error, and it mentions the warn-only behavior only as how older versions worked.
It states that Vitest 5 adds vi.when() and presents the mockImplementation workaround only for Vitest 4 or earlier, not as current.
It states that vitest list parses files statically by default instead of running them, and it does not present execution-based collection as current.
It states that Vitest 5+ joins suite and test names with `>` and presents the space separator only as the older pre-v5 behavior.
